statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 are on record
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204

Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
